query: Which practical variance-reduction strategies (GAE windows, control variates, bootstrapping) most effectively reduce TD error in continuous multi-agent multi-objective settings?

response.query: Which practical variance-reduction strategies (GAE windows, control variates, bootstrapping) most effectively reduce TD error in continuous multi-agent multi-objective settings?
response.answer: In continuous multi-agent multi-objective settings, GAE windows and control variates most effectively reduce TD error. Bootstrapping is less commonly used in this context.
